name: CDC
role: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — national epidemiological lead
quote: The true number of sick people in this multistate outbreak is likely higher than the number reported, and the outbreak may not be limited to the states with known illnesses.

name: CDC Health Alert Network
role: Issued the July 14 national clinician advisory on domestically acquired cyclosporiasis
quote: Clinicians should consider Cyclospora testing for patients with prolonged watery diarrhea and consult local health departments about ongoing multistate investigations.

name: FDA
role: Food and Drug Administration — traceback investigation and recall coordination
quote: Epidemiologic and traceback data showed that iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms de Mexico was contaminated with Cyclospora and made people sick.

name: FDA CORE Network
role: Coordinated Outbreak Response and Evaluation team leading the border-sample retraction and on-site Guanajuato inspection
quote: The border sample result does not represent true amplification and has been withdrawn; our investigation into the source of contamination continues.

name: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services
role: State health department managing the largest single-state caseload in the outbreak
quote: Both individuals who died had underlying health conditions. Michigan's cumulative case count is now 13,909, with 314 hospitalizations.

name: North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services
role: State health department investigating a separate parsley/cilantro-linked cluster
quote: North Carolina's cases do not appear to be associated with the outbreak in other states involving Taco Bell; parsley, cilantro, and lettuce remain under investigation. As of Aug 26, the cluster totals 940 cases and 32 hospitalizations.

name: Washington State Department of Health
role: State health department tracking mostly travel-linked cases with no in-state recalled product distribution
quote: The recalled Taylor Farms de Mexico lettuce has no reported distribution to Washington state; most of our cases involve travel to endemic countries or outbreak states.

name: Ohio Department of Health
role: State health department coordinating with CDC on the multistate Taco Bell-linked cluster
quote: We are working closely with CDC and FDA to identify all Ohio residents affected by the multistate outbreak and ensure recalled product is off shelves.

name: Bruce Taylor
role: CEO, Taylor Farms — company at the center of the traceback investigation
quote: We take food safety extremely seriously and are cooperating fully with FDA, CDC, and Mexican regulators to identify the source of contamination.

name: Taco Bell Corp.
role: Restaurant chain that removed produce from affected locations and faces litigation
quote: Out of an abundance of caution, we removed fresh produce items from restaurants in the affected states and are supporting the ongoing FDA and CDC investigation.

name: Walmart Inc.
role: Retailer whose Marketside private-label bagged lettuce was recalled
quote: We immediately pulled the affected Marketside bagged lettuce from shelves upon notification and are working with our supplier and regulators on this recall.

name: International Fresh Produce Association
role: Produce industry trade association providing consumer guidance during the outbreak
quote: The vast majority of fresh produce in the U.S. market remains safe; consumers should follow FDA recall notices closely rather than avoiding fresh produce broadly.

name: Rep. Robert Garcia (D-CA)
role: Ranking Member, House Oversight Committee — leading congressional inquiry into Taylor Farms
quote: We are concerned Taylor Farms may have attempted to influence FDA's outbreak investigation and misled consumers about the scope of the recall.

name: COFEPRIS / SENASICA
role: Mexican federal health and agri-food safety regulators that inspected the Guanajuato facility
quote: Laboratory analyses of lettuce and water samples from the Taylor Farms de México facility showed no presence of Cyclospora cayetanensis or fecal coliforms.

name: Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-MA)
role: U.S. Senator pressing HHS Secretary RFK Jr. over the federal outbreak response
quote: I write regarding the administration's calamitous response to the biggest outbreak of cyclosporiasis in U.S. history, and the extent to which the outbreak and botched response may be the result of incompetence and corruption.

name: Dr. Natasha Bagdasarian
role: Michigan Chief Medical Executive — leading the state's outbreak response as case growth slows
quote: The worst is behind us, at least based on the data we have available to us today.

name: Bill Marler
role: Food-safety attorney and outbreak litigation watchdog (Marler Clark)
quote: FDA quietly revised its recall distribution list on August 13 to add nine more states and territories — but as far as I can find, not one of them has told its own residents.
